name: @hearth/infra
description: The AWS CDK app (T9, D37; TECH-SPEC T24): one workspace with two entries, run by Node 24 as the server is (T2). bin/workload.ts is the deploy pipeline's, account-agnostic; bin/landing-zone.ts is a person's, from their own environment. Coding agents synth and test, never deploy.

scripts.synth:lz: env -i PATH="$PATH" HOME="$(mktemp -d)" AWS_CONFIG_FILE=/dev/null AWS_SHARED_CREDENTIALS_FILE=/dev/null AWS_EC2_METADATA_DISABLED=true CDK_DISABLE_CLI_TELEMETRY=true CDK_DISABLE_VERSION_CHECK=true HEARTH_FIXTURE=1 cdk synth --app 'node bin/landing-zone.ts' --no-lookups --no-notices --quiet
